thread.t: Round 1 my read: the greige studio look and the suit drape read high fashion. Strongest 03 hang tag, 04 tissue seal, 05 garment cover, 07 invitation, 10 phone, 11 tablet. 01 bag carried is too far, not tight like the reference. 06 neck label shows her chin and lips, do not use.

Round 2 my read: the black and white feel from your inspo landed and the four new looks read high fashion, not corporate. Strongest 01 bag in elbow, 02 bag at arm's length, 06 hang tag on raised arm, 08 garment cover on hook, 10 invitation, 13 phone at hip, 14 phone in cuff, 15 tablet on knees. Too far, full figure with space around: 03, 16, 17, 18. Check 03, 17 and 18 at full size, the top crop may show her chin. 07 tissue seal reads like a gift box. 09 label is small.
